scientific_integrity: Analytical conditional-score and martingale proofs; finite numerical checks are diagnostics rather than infinite proof. Publication novelty is a qualified research judgment, not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed known nonzero Rabi frequency, perfect synchronous full-Poisson resets, stationary single snapshot, initial pure product reset state and ideal qubit measurements
Information-optimality is an N-to-infinity limit at fixed positive reset rate; the small-rate asymptotics apply to the population-limit information and do not assert a uniform double-scaling result
No finite-N quantum Fisher closed form, estimator bias/variance performance, noisy implementation, or independence audit is asserted
Classical conditional-score and martingale principles are standard and not claimed new; coverage by broader unindexed work remains a research-priority risk
title: A finite quantum Fisher ceiling and phase-aliasing separation for globally reset Rabi spins
